title: The Founding Identity: How Punjab Kings Became More Than an IPL Entry
dek: Every franchise starts with a first season and a first squad. Punjab Kings' began in 2008; what that year looked like still shapes how they are seen.
excerpt: Punjab Kings played their first season in 2008, led by SE Marsh with the bat and S Sreesanth with the ball. Some of that first squad stayed long enough to become the franchise's foundation.

sections.heading: More Than an Entry
body: A franchise becomes more than a team in a league when it builds continuity: players, a home ground and a recognisable way of playing that outlast a single season.

sections.heading: What the First Season Did Not Decide
body: First seasons are not destiny. Results, squads and owners change; the founding year is a starting point, not a prediction.
The later history of PBKS is told season by season elsewhere in this series.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: The Founders Who Stayed
body: Punjab Kings' founding identity rests on the players from 2008 who stayed. {{ev:fi-stayed}} of them played five or more seasons.
Those players are the bridge between the first squad and everything that followed.
